meta.title: The Flashiest Raw Selvedge Denim Jeans on Earth. (Momotaro)
meta.description:
Momotaro! Raw denim! Raw Japanese SELVEDGE denim at that! Who would have guessed that?! Me do a review on that!?!??!

Do you like me...follow me on IG @8thWeekday  
Do you hate me...follow me on IG @8thWeekday  

https://momotaro-jeans.com

There are few names that loom (ha loom) as large in the raw denim world as Momotaro. They are one of the most legendary Japanese denim brands...ever. They make incredible selvedge denim and have some daring choices to boot! What do I think of them? Should you just stick with a pair of Levi's? Are they too flashy? Find out this week on THE TALE OF THE IRON SNAILLLLLLL.

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
